test_programs.policy: The upstream program stores new instruction bytes, executes fence.i, then fetches from the stored address. The fetch forces the I-cache to request the line from L2 while the D-cache may still hold it dirty, so L2 issues a TileLink Probe (channel B) to the D-cache that ProbeUnit must forward to the D-cache pipeline for a response. The fixed D-cache patch also sends two line probes to a separate ProbeUnit and uses a fixed WriteBackUnit to generate the ban while the older probe is acknowledged.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches. The separate observation in rv64ui-p-fence_i must complete. It checks accepted addresses and forbids forwarding during the ban.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Check two accepted probe addresses and rule out downstream handoff during the WriteBackUnit ban.
